autoquant_scale_policy.note: Layer maps and BF16 weights were preserved; search was not rerun after removing scale tensors.

accuracy_drop.rounding: Differences use unrounded input scores; table rounds half up to two decimal places.
accuracy_drop.uncertainty: Point-estimate differences. CSV stderr_pp refers to each absolute accuracy, not the difference. No paired significance test is implied.

uncertainty.general: Retained evaluator SE unless the CSV uncertainty_basis specifies a reconstruction or approximation. Repeated completions do not add independent benchmark problems.
uncertainty.scicode_bf16_nvfp4: Approximate binomial SE: 100 * sqrt(p * (1-p) / 2704); repeated completions treated as independent.
uncertainty.scicode_native_6p25: Mean of three independent run scores: 543/2704, 519/2704, 524/2704. SE is their sample SD / sqrt(3). CSV response counts sum across the three runs.
uncertainty.scicode_other: Repeat-derived standard errors retained in the CSV.

coverage.six_non_scicode_tasks: Complete successful response coverage for every displayed cell.
coverage.scicode: Fixed denominator 2704 per run; missing and unsuccessful generations remain failures.
coverage.withheld: NVFP4 and NVFP4 Four-over-Six AIME2025 controls used unmatched runtime/topology. Legacy-kernel results and unavailable matched AA-LCR, TauBench2, and TerminalBench results are excluded.

payload.scope: Calculated KV payload; not total GPU memory, throughput, or concurrency.

IFBench.stderr_method: sample standard error reconstructed from the five cumulative prompt-loose repeat aggregates

availability: Development runtime and study checkpoints are not distributed with the blog. The pinned merged starter example uses a different candidate menu and search dataset. Local BF16 results have not been independently reproduced under the same evaluation contract.
